description: A watercolor painting lies on the desk with a cup of water, a small stack of paper towels, and a paint palette to the right. The left hand stays near the lower edge of the paper while the right hand lifts the paintbrush from the painting, moves up and left to dip and swirl it in the water cup as a right-hand object, then pulls the brush out and shifts right toward the palette, returning toward the painting to continue.
